text:
sam: quick esk — acme reported rerank endpoint returning 400 for some requests, customer says started after SDK update
support-bot: ticket #C-4821 created
sam: here's the curl they sent:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n -d '{
  "queries": ["is product A better than B?"],
  "top_k": null,
  "candidates": "[]"
}'
```
anna: looks like top_k is null and candidates is a string (double-encoded). Our schema requires integer top_k and candidates array
kevin: yup. validation error in logs: validation_error: 'body.candidates must be array' + 'body.top_k must be integer'
shilpa: repro locally with same payload -> 400. Repro steps:
- curl as above
- server returns 400 {"error":"validation_error","details":["top_k must be integer","candidates must be array"]}
kevin: customer says it worked on SDK v2.2.9 and started failing on v2.3.1
anna: ask them to send SDK version and full request headers. Also suggest temp workaround: set top_k to 1 (or omit) and send candidates as [] not quoted
sam: sent workaround, customer says they need to patch quickly, can we relax validation for stringified arrays?
shilpa: I don't recommend silently accepting stringified arrays — risk of hiding bugs. We can improve error message to say "candidates must be an array, not a string. If using our JS SDK update to latest or JSON.parse before sending."
kevin: I'll file a docs bug and add clearer error code + link to SDK migration guide. tagging @jordan for runtime opinion
sam: thanks — I'll follow up with customer and include repro logs + suggested fix :thumbsup:
